items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So she said right away, "I want Kenny Clarke first."

ctx.x: I stayed in New York all winter, and that

spring, Madame Nicole Barclay, who owned the Barclay Record Company here, she came to New York to form a group to play the First Paris Festival. So she said right away, "I want Kenny Clarke first." Now, you'll get whoever else you want, but Kenny Clarke is first." Now, this was what she told the agents, so they were up in the air. They didn't know what to do.
